coverageSpotVerification.detail: Every suite-required assertion of M1-M6 and M8 is mapped (coverage-manifest.json regenerated byte-identically in milestone lists and test names by the grader's clean-checkout run). Each sampled test exercises its assertion's observable. Thin but honest mappings: m2-a16 checks repost attribution through the API event rather than the rendered label (grader observed 'Reposted by <name>' on web); m5-a04 checks a first authorized asset read rather than a UI open; m8-a01 checks the server summary rather than the screen (grader observed screen equal to server). Mappings are generated by the same check() call that runs the test, so a mapped ID cannot pass without its test body completing. No divergence between suiteResult and grader result.

defects.summary: Schema enables `use identity` (guests and password accounts), so POST /auth/guest mints a guest session without email or password; a guest could create a profile, publish a post and open a DM with a registered persona. The brief's identity is email + password signup only.

Server-side password minimum is 8 UTF-8 bytes, not 8 characters: a 4-character password of two-byte letters is accepted through the API (the UI alone enforces 8 code points). Disclosed in the lane README.

Following feed for viewers with >=100 follows uses a global index scan with a follow-edge filter; per the lane's own README the platform can exhaust its read meter and return an incomplete page when followed authors are sparse (N_SPARSE_FILTER). The dense scale fixture does not trigger it.

The builder's receipt also records one attempt of repost-following-feed-surface observing a viewer repost counted as a direct follow-projection hit before recovering.

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and ~90 ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts").
O1.justification: 101 of 119 assertions pass under grading (M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 15/15, M4 12/12, M5 12/12, M6 6/13, M7 0/9, M8 16/18). M1-M5 and the web-authored parts of M6/M8 are solid, including every [grader] assertion (m1-a07, m1-a12/13, m4-a10/12, m5-a01..03/06, m6-a12, m8-a08..12). Held below 90 because M7 is not-run (9 assertions in the denominator) and no iOS simulator artifact exists for the 7 M6 and 2 M8 native-artifact assertions. See trace.md §2-§5.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and ~90 ("only cosmetic nits").
O2.justification: No blocker or major defect found. Five minor defects (d-01 guest sessions enabled beside password auth; d-02 byte-based server password minimum; d-03 disclosed sparse broad-follow Following page can be incomplete; d-04 intermittent >10 s Following projection after a follow toggle, reproduced in builder and grader runs; d-05 video bubble renders before its media element, causing one harness miss) and one cosmetic (d-06 binary unread badge). Authorization, validation, window, revocation, and idempotency exploration all behaved correctly (trace.md §4.1).

O4.anchorsCited: At ~30 ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app"), short of ~60 ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush"), which needs reads demonstrated on the native proof.
O4.justification: No simulator artifact was recorded for M6 or M8 (native-artifacts.json simulatorProof=false; both segment receipts list ios-simulator-mN as not-recorded), so cold-start offline reads, previously viewed media, cold offline search, view-once exclusion, native queued writes, and M8's durable-queue restart are all undemonstrated. The web choreography receipts (builder and grader re-run) do show warm-offline search, offline sends with a visible pending state that flush in order and reach read, and M8 dual-offline convergence with receipts advancing. The lane states the gap honestly (README: exports establish build compatibility; no simulator proofs claimed). Placed at the 30 anchor: no native offline behavior demonstrated, partly offset by web write-queue evidence and honest disclosure.

O5.bandRationale: First-match order 0,30,60,90,75 over the lane replay record (evidence/scale-final-result.json, evidence/performance-summary.json; builder-run, since no probe set was committed). 0 did not fire: every checkpoint (10%, 50%, final) passed the invariant-manifest checks including all named O5 fixtures, and the grader independently re-verified a copy of the retained final store (celebrity 900 followers and 200 posts, probe user 500 follows and 100 conversations, u0901 following list exact, u0005 5 follows, g0001 50-member roster and 10,000 unique messages by full paging, 10 sampled chats and 10 sampled users' following counts all exact); replay wall 292 s, not exhausted. 30 did not fire: all degradation rules passed on the builder's k=20-after-3-warm-up measurements (Following 500/5 = 1.26x; celebrity-follower/5-follow = 1.03x; history page 50/page 1 = 0.97x; search final/10% = 1.11x with 50% under the line; Insights 2.22x with 50% under the line; Trending 1.21x with 50% under the line; celebrity write/5-follower write = 0.91x), no probe timed out or errored, and probe-user cold sync took 640 ms. 60 did not fire and 90 cannot be established: absolute ceilings and the replay wall cap are uncalibrated placeholders in the frozen brief, so no ceiling can be exceeded and neither ceiling utilization <=50% nor cap use <=50% can be shown. 75 applies (otherwise).

notes: N=1 calibration grading, not a claim-eligible wave, with these recorded deviations. (1) No holdout probe set was committed for this wave: execution-order phase 4 was skipped, wave.probeSetSha256 = none-uncommitted, probeResults is empty (note: no probe set existed, so no probe ran and none was invented). Consequently O3 is recorded null: applicability makes O3 applicable (M6 green, M1-M5 attempted), but its rule scores it only from the wave's rotated holdout probes and none exist; the grader's own trust-boundary checks (trace.md §4.1, all correctly denied) are non-scored diagnostics. O5 is band-mapped from the lane's builder-run replay record, independently spot-verified by the grader. (2) The claude family has not passed the grader calibration gate: calibrationPassed=false, sameFamilyGraded=false; this record is an uncalibrated-grader grade. (3) Timing-sensitive checks are judged best-of-3; builder choreography receipts carry no load figure, and grader-executed timings record uptime load averages (7.7-11.5 on a shared 18-core host). Additional facts: builder choreography receipts for M1, M2, M4, M5 and M6 predate the lane's final source edits, so the grader re-ran the byte-identical frozen harness copy against the final build with a grader-environment setup identity (Node 24.18.0 instead of the builder's declared 25.9.0, otherwise identical pins). All segments were green except one M4 miss that passed on its single re-run (d-05). The frozen schema permits only M1-M7 IDs, so this report carries exactly the 101 IDs of GRADER_ASSERTIONS_101.txt; the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json. M7 is not-run for all nine assertions because the fresh M7 session has not run.
